recipes.name: c-class
recipes.title: C programming class
recipes.for: students and teachers on managed Chromebooks and laptops where nothing can be installed
recipes.args: repo (optional https URL of the starter code)

recipes.name: claude-sandbox
recipes.title: Claude Code in a throwaway machine
recipes.for: people who want a coding agent that can't touch their real disk
recipes.args: repo (optional https URL of the repository to work on)

recipes.name: latex-paper
recipes.title: LaTeX project, no compile time limit
recipes.for: people whose paper hits an online editor's compile timeout, or who can't upload it
recipes.args: repo (optional https URL of the paper's repository), main (main .tex file, default main.tex)

recipes.name: python-class
recipes.title: Python class
recipes.for: students on machines where Python can't be installed
recipes.args: repo (optional https URL of the course's repository), pip (optional package names, space-separated)

recipes.name: untrusted-repo
recipes.title: Look inside a repo or archive you don't trust
recipes.for: people sent a repository or tarball they don't trust (a "take-home test", an "NDA branch")
recipes.args: url (optional https URL of a git repository or an archive; or put files in ~/run/untrusted-repo/in)

recipes.name: wordperfect-rescue
recipes.title: Rescue old documents (WordPerfect, Works, ClarisWorks, Visio, CorelDraw)
recipes.for: people with old files they can't open and won't upload
